QuestInfo.name: We Want Answers
QuestInfo.0: The puzzle fell into place and everything made sense. #p2400008# had been behind them the entire time, following them with his 'dowsing' readings, when in reality he was working for the Shadow Knights! But why?
QuestInfo.1: #p2400007# chased #p2400008# out of the temple, and watched him run off for Shadowvale. #p2400005# and #p2400006# had to find out why they'd been betrayed, despite #p2400007#'s advice to stay away from Shadowvale.
QuestInfo.2: #p2400008#'s concern for #p2400005# and #p2400006# drove him to betray them. He feared that if #p2470018#, the Goddess of Time, was sealed away so easily by the Black Mage, what hope would the two of them have? At least Mirror World would keep them alive...

npc.0: Well, I can't stop you two from going to Shadowvale...
